development_status: All model fitting and K selection used only the frozen n=14/n=16 development cases listed in the model file. K=24 was selected before the holdout outcomes because OOF K=24 matched OOF K=32 final aggregate quality while charging fewer candidate compilations. No holdout seed below has been used for fitting, thresholding or K selection.
hypothesis: The failure of fixed prefixes is partly caused by arbitrary expensive-candidate evaluation order. A cheap source-qualified structural ranker can increase useful information per BDD compilation by moving low-live seeded neighbors earlier, making a bounded probe more effective without changing the legal candidate set or final local-search semantics.
canonicalization: Wrap every generated graph as nx.Graph(generator_output). Use the same natural, reverse-Cuthill-McKee and seeded-start generation as the frozen v0 family. Candidate legality remains remove/reinsert with vertex-separation width <= current seeded width + 1.

ranked_k24_policy.cheap_scoring: Compute all model-file features for every legal seeded neighbor without BDD compilation, standardize with the frozen scaler, score by frozen Ridge prediction, sort ascending prediction then original deterministic candidate index, and BDD-compile only the first 24 candidates plus the seeded start.
ranked_k24_policy.seeded_stage: Among evaluated candidates use existing (live, allocated, lexicographic order) tie-break; accept only a strict live improvement over seeded start.
ranked_k24_policy.three_arm_commit: Stage natural and RCM fully as before, stage seeded only with ranked K24, choose winner using existing (stage live, stage charged candidate compilations, fixed priority rcm<natural<seeded), then continue only the winner to at most two accepted local moves total.

matched_original_k24: Identical to ranked K24 except seeded candidates are evaluated in the existing deterministic enumeration order rather than Ridge score order.

co_primary_mechanism_criteria.minimum_live_capture: Across all 24 cases, ranked K24 must increase the fraction of cases whose evaluated seeded set contains a global minimum-live legal seeded neighbor by at least 0.20 absolute over original-order K24.
co_primary_mechanism_criteria.matched_policy_pareto: Ranked K24 aggregate final live-node sum must be <= original-order K24, and ranked K24 total charged candidate compilations must be <= original-order K24. Any positive quality regression or extra charged compute versus original K24 fails this criterion.

deployment_diagnostics.two_arm: Report aggregate live delta and charged compile overhead versus plain two-arm. Mark deployment-useful on this split only if ranked K24 final live sum is strictly lower than two-arm and charged compile overhead is <=5%.
deployment_diagnostics.always_three: Report aggregate positive regret versus per-case min(two-arm,always-three), total benefit captured, and charged compile reduction versus always-three. Do not call benefit retention established if fewer than two always-three-benefit cases occur.

oracle_contract: Search candidates may use invariant Hamming-rank checking. Every distinct completed policy endpoint must match exhaustive direct truth bits in its own relabeled coordinates; do not compare raw assignment-indexed truth bitsets across variable orders.
no_recalibration: Do not change model coefficients/scaler/features, K=24, candidate legality, candidate ordering tie-break, seeds, generators, commit semantics or criteria after outcomes. Any revision requires a new untouched split.
scope: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD variable-order search on these 24 frozen n=18 cases only. This tests candidate-evaluation ordering and bounded test-time compute, not a general theorem-proving claim.
